title: A 99-million-year-old fossil reveals how ancient lizards shed their tails to escape predators
description: An extraordinary fossil found in Myanmar's amber reveals 99 million-year-old evidence of intentional lizard tail shedding. By employing X-ray micro-computed tomography, scientists were able to analyze this Cretaceous specimen, identifying that the tail was deliberately detached – mirroring current lizard behavior. This discovery bridges the gap in understanding the evolution of tail regeneration, highlighting ancient survival strategies in the animal kingdom.
